profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Animoto
profile.summary: I love working with JavaScript and all the latest front end technologies out there today.  In particular I have been having a lot of fun using the Ember.js framework at work and for personal projects. I enjoy using the Go programming language to create server side solutions. One of the coolest parts about what I do is it's always evolving and fresh. I'm really interested in BDD (behavior-driven development) as well as TDD ( test-driven development ) and have been incorporating techniques from each in my own personal projects and at work.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Tech lead · Node.js · React.js · Kubernetes · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Staff Engineer, Full stack
positions.description:
- Created distributed system to archive inactive users in our system to help with AWS cost savings.

- Helped with migration of our Kubernetes KOPS cluster to AWS EKS. My main focus was setting up our secure internal service mesh layer to use AWS App Mesh.

- Helped extend and improve our internal Kubernetes management tool written in GoLang.

- Lead project to integrate our marketing video creation application with Facebook App Store.

positions.title: Senior Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Mentored engineers and interns helping them brainstorm approaches to implement new features, pair programming and helping them feel comfortable with React/Redux framework concepts.

 - Worked on incrementally migrating our legacy BackboneJS apps to React javascript framework and establish a pattern for developers in the company to follow.

- Helped establish a company wide React component library that various product teams could leverage. This included setting up the CI/CD pipeline for the library and deploying Storybook static site for every version to help Designers and Developers collaborate better.

- Helped establish shared internal Javascript modules that engineers across product teams could leverage to speed up there work and prevent code duplication. This included setting up the CI/CD pipeline.

- Helped migrate our Marketing landing page and blog to JAMStack React based Gatsby framework. 

- Helped fully convert our new marketing builder video creation tool to React/Redux.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as Front End Engineer in cross functional team to develop new web based video marketing creation tool geared towards business customers.

- Worked on integrating with third party asset APIs to ingest user media assets into our system so they could be used during video creation workflow.

- Explored migrating code base from BackboneJS to React javascript framework.

positions.title: Senior Front End Developer
positions.description: Leading initiatives to use modern JavaScript frameworks and tools, using jQuery, Ember.js, QUnit, GruntJS and RequireJS to develop rich web applications. The web applications I develop are used by service based businesses to manage there day to day operations and also by their customers to book and pay for services.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed custom travel reservation websites for international customers using VB.Net and Javascript programming languages together with jQuery and AJAX  to create dynamic data driven websites.  Worked with XML and XLST to deliver content to sites.  Created custom CMS data structures for specific customer needs.  Help debug and fix errors on customer sites.

positions.title: Jr. Clarify Administrator
positions.description: Monitored Unix Jobs using CA Workload Automation.  Worked with Oracle 11g database to fix data issues.  Created and tested PL/SQL packages and procedures

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description: Debug and customize aircraft maintenance software using PowerBuilder.  Work with XML and XSLT to make PDF reports.  Created new PL/SQL packages and procedures to optimize software.  Maintain and modify service pack creation software using Java JDBC and Prepared Statements using Eclipse IDE.  Maintain customer Oracle 10g Database using SQL and PL/SQL.  Communicate with international customers to update TRAX software and Oracle 10g Database.
